components.summary: Derive quality closure from the real reader chain, saved native verdicts and in-process domain checks.
responsibilities: Derive quality closure from the real reader chain, saved native verdicts and in-process domain checks.
Known-bad edits are caught or listed as toothless closure risks.
Saved provider reports count only when they belong to the brief.
state: Computed quality status, provider verdicts, residual risks and broad-claim permission.

components.summary: Read one native ResearchGuard verdict and preserve atomic native source anchors.
responsibilities: Read one native ResearchGuard verdict and preserve atomic native source anchors.

components.summary: Shared canonical identity, request loading and JSON schema validation used by existing domain owners.
responsibilities: Preserve canonical content fingerprints and strict JSON schema validation shared by existing domain owners.

Load command requests whose reviewed object and list fields name JSON files; resolve relative artifact paths against the file that contains them while preserving scalar identifiers and opaque native result locators, and fill fingerprints a caller leaves out (load_request, fill_fingerprint, fill_missing). Resolve saved provider report paths relative to the closure request without loading or executing providers.
Keep same-key records available from partial result envelopes; reject failed envelopes without the requested record with their first error before sole-object fallback.
Resolve revision source paths against their containing request/record files and describe source-file provenance in the current schema.
Resolve research_folder and composition-owned input paths without executing native providers; preserve optional new-writing provenance and opaque native locators.
A saved world report must name the world contract's id.
side_effects: Write JSON only to an explicit output file requested by a command.
